scope: The named Kotlin block is extracted verbatim, compiled with kotlinc, and run on the JVM. It proves only this pure Kotlin/JVM program; it does not cover Android Studio, Gradle, Android SDK, Compose, an emulator, a device, or an APK.

results.command: docker run --rm -v <temporary-directory>:/work -w /work dev-quest-validation:local sh -c 'kotlinc EnvironmentCheck.kt -include-runtime -d /tmp/environment-check.jar && java -jar /tmp/environment-check.jar'
